desc: This is the final leg of our adventure across Arizona. We leave the Tucson area and move East towards the Chiricahua National Monument. We see so many rock features close to something you would see much farther North in the Black Hills. Follow along and please like and subscribe!

title: Altitude: 1, Us: 0 - Hiking Chiricahua | Truck Camper Life

desc:
Altitude: 1, Us: 0 - Hiking Chiricahua | Truck Camper Life 

Looking for truck camper boondocking adventures and epic high-altitude hikes? We found an amazing remote campsite deep in the Coronado National Forest, then tackled the stunning hiking trails at Chiricahua National Monument in Arizona. After living at sea level for 3 months, hiking between 5,400 and 7,000 feet was no joke—altitude sickne
